Authors: KwangBin Lee

Training-Free Target-Aware Refinement of 3D Gaussian Language Map Locomotion

3D Gaussian Splatting language map training-free refinement open-vocabulary segmentation language-goal navigation

简要说明：本文提出一种无需训练的目标感知细化方法，用于三维高斯语言地图，通过将目标文本嵌入注入检测区域来提升语言目标定位和开放词汇分割性能，并在真实腿式机器人导航中进行了验证。

TLDR: This paper proposes a training-free, target-aware refinement for 3D Gaussian language maps, which injects target text embeddings into detected regions to improve language-goal localization and open-vocabulary segmentation, demonstrated in real-world legged robot navigation.

Abstract: Distilling vision-language features into 3D Gaussian Splatting yields a language map that can be queried with arbitrary text. In deployment, however, a small set of user-specified targets must be reliably located, which current distilled maps often miss, while open-vocabulary queryability for other words must remain intact. We propose a training-free, target-aware refinement of an already-distilled language map. Guided by a text-promptable segmenter, the visual embedding inside each detected target region is blended with the target text embedding, a convex combination whose coefficient sets the amount of injected prior, while non-target regions are left untouched. Injecting too much overwrites appearance cues and general queryability, so we seek, for each target, the smallest coefficient that still lets it win, and we obtain every coefficient in closed form, leaving no hyperparameters to tune. We further identify a failure mode of injection in language-goal localization. Text embeddings share a common component, and injecting them makes the standard cosine read-out query-agnostic, which a centering step in the read-out removes. Across three benchmarks, the refinement consistently improves open-vocabulary segmentation, roughly doubling the base mIoU on Replica, and localizes language goals more reliably than the base map. It also transfers as a plug-in to off-the-shelf field-based and object-level language maps and supports a real-world demonstration in which a legged robot navigates to natural-language goals. Project page and code: https://lab-of-ai-and-robotics.github.io/target-aware-langmap/

摘要（中文）：将视觉语言特征蒸馏到3D高斯溅射中，可生成一张能够以任意文本进行查询的语言地图。然而在实际部署中，往往需要可靠地定位一小部分用户指定的目标，而当前的蒸馏地图常常遗漏这些目标，同时针对其他词汇的开放词汇查询能力必须保持不变。我们提出了一种无需训练、目标感知的已蒸馏语言地图精化方法。在文本提示分割器的引导下，每个检测到的目标区域内部的视觉嵌入与目标文本嵌入进行混合，采用凸组合方式，其系数控制注入先验的强度，而非目标区域则保持不变。过度注入会覆盖外观线索并损害通用查询能力，因此我们针对每个目标寻找既能确保其胜出的最小系数，并以闭式解获得所有系数，无需调节任何超参数。我们还识别出语言目标定位中注入方法的一种失效模式：文本嵌入共享公共分量，注入后会使标准余弦读出变得与查询无关，而读出过程中的中心化步骤可消除该问题。在三个基准测试中，该精化方法持续提升了开放词汇分割性能，在Replica上将基础mIoU大约提升了一倍，并且比基础地图更可靠地定位语言目标。该方法还可作为即插即用模块迁移至现成的基于场和基于对象级别的语言地图，并支持了一项真实世界演示——四足机器人导航至自然语言目标。项目主页及代码：https://lab-of-ai-and-robotics.github.io/target-aware-langmap/

Authors: Sibaek Lee, Kyeongsu Kang, Seongbo Ha, Yewon Jeon, Joonyeol Choi, Daegeol Ko, Jaehyuk Hur, Taemin Choi, Minsu Kim, Hyungjoo Ahn, Wonsok Yoo, Hyeonwoo Yu

AVALON: Zero-Shot Indoor Navigation with Human-Seeded Topological Memory VLN

topological navigation human-seeded memory zero-shot point-goal navigation indoor service robot

简要说明：AVALON提出了一种基于人工种子化拓扑记忆的室内导航框架，使机器人在未知建筑中无需预先映射即可零样本导航，并在Unitree Go2上验证了其高效性。

TLDR: AVALON presents a topological navigation framework for indoor service robots that leverages human-seeded spatial memory and node-verified execution to achieve zero-shot navigation in unmapped buildings, demonstrated on a Unitee Go2 robot with faster completion times than prior methods.

Abstract: Indoor service robots often enter unmapped buildings whose layouts and task constraints are already familiar to users. We address this human-familiar, robot-unseen setting with AVALON, a topological navigation framework organized around human-seeded layered spatial memory, node-verified topological execution, and task-triggered, evidence-gated human--robot memory co-updating. The robot has no prior on-site traversal or site-specific training. Deployment requires only a floor plan, place clues, and an initial topology-odometry alignment. Visual depth point-goal navigation leverages verified node arrivals to perform translational re-anchoring, without requiring a robot-constructed global SLAM map. Human--robot memory co-updating fuses complementary sources of information. Human operators specify task constraints that are unobservable via vision and report offline environmental modifications, whereas the robot provides physical-state evidence through active in-situ validation. Task relevance governs whether human-reported environmental changes undergo robot validation during the active mission. Field-collected perceptual evidence gates memory updates, maintaining an explicit separation between human-specified permissions and robot-observed traversability. Our experiments on a Unitree Go2 show that AVALON with X-NavDP completes a 12.81 m Intersection-to-Dining mission in 46.4 s (5/5) with no mapping, 40.9% less robot time than DimOS-Go2 (78.5 s, 4/5), while policy-only X-NavDP times out in all of the 5 runs. These demonstrate the superiority of the proposed topological navigation framework.

摘要（中文）：室内服务机器人常常需要进入未建图建筑，而用户已熟悉这些建筑的布局和任务约束。我们针对这一“人类熟悉、机器人未知”的场景提出了AVALON，一种拓扑导航框架，其核心包括基于人工种子分层空间记忆、节点验证的拓扑执行，以及任务触发、证据门控的人机记忆协同更新。机器人无需预先实地遍历或站点特定训练。部署仅需平面图、地点线索和初始拓扑-里程计对齐。视觉深度点目标导航利用已验证的节点到达进行平移重新锚定，无需机器人构建全局SLAM地图。人机记忆协同更新融合了互补信息源：人类操作员指定视觉无法观测的任务约束，并报告离线环境变化；机器人则通过主动现场验证提供物理状态证据。任务相关性决定人类报告的环境变化是否在主动任务期间接受机器人验证。现场收集的感知证据门控记忆更新，保持人类指定权限与机器人观测可通行性之间的明确分离。我们在Unitree Go2上的实验表明，AVALON结合X-NavDP在46.4秒内完成12.81米的交叉口至餐厅任务（5/5成功率），无需建图，比DimOS-Go2（78.5秒，4/5成功率）节省40.9%的机器人耗时，而仅依赖策略的X-NavDP在全部5次运行中均超时。这些结果证明了所提拓扑导航框架的优越性。

Authors: Jing Xia, Changyan Li, Yuduo Wang, Guiyin Tian, Bo Wang, Yifan Liao, Mingjun Li, Shiyan Hu

Attribution-Gated Joint Estimation of Intention and Capability for Assist-as-Needed Upper-Limb Robots Manipulation

assist-as-needed human-robot interaction intention estimation capability estimation model predictive control

简要说明：该论文提出一种用于上肢机器人的按需辅助（AAN）控制框架，通过归因门联合估计用户意图与能力，从而在运动与交互响应模糊的情况下自适应调整辅助。实验表明该方法提高了轨迹跟踪精度并适应疲劳状态。

TLDR: This paper presents an assist-as-needed (AAN) control framework for upper-limb robots that jointly estimates user intention and capability via an attribution gate, enabling adaptive assistance despite ambiguous kinematic and interaction responses. Experiments with healthy participants demonstrate improved trajectory tracking and fatigue-adaptive assistance.

Abstract: Assist-as-needed (AAN) control must distinguish between changes in intended motion and changes in effective voluntary torque capability, even though both can produce similar kinematic and interaction responses. A dual-measurand multimodal MHE-MPC architecture is developed as the base framework, in which the intended trajectory and the task-dependent effective voluntary torque capability are estimated online as distinct quantities, and both estimates are used to adapt robotic assistance. Building on this architecture, the ambiguity between the two update channels is formulated as a continuous credit-assignment problem and resolved by an attribution gate. A trajectory-change indicator is obtained from persistent corrective interaction, whereas a capability-change indicator is derived from the residual between normalized muscle activation and dynamics-reconstructed voluntary torque. Nine healthy participants completed factorial target-height-load trials and a pre-post fatigue cup-transport task. Without target-height input, the gated method generated correctly ordered Low-Middle-High references under every load: target changes were preferentially assigned to trajectory adaptation, whereas added load shifted adaptation toward the capability channel. It achieved the lowest RMSE in all nine conditions (0.017 rad versus 0.041 rad for ungated dual estimation and 0.127 rad for fixed-reference error-based AAN). Post-fatigue capability estimates decreased and assistance increased at all heights, supporting functional feasibility.

摘要（中文）：辅助按需（AAN）控制必须区分预期运动的变化与有效自主力矩能力的变化，尽管两者可能产生相似的运动学和交互响应。本文开发了一种双测量量多模态MHE-MPC架构作为基础框架，在该框架中，预期轨迹和任务相关的有效自主力矩能力被分别作为独立量进行在线估计，并利用这两类估计值自适应调整机器人辅助力度。在此架构基础上，两个更新通道之间的模糊性被建模为连续信用分配问题，并通过归因门控机制予以解决。轨迹变化指标通过持续性纠正交互获得，而能力变化指标则由归一化肌肉激活与动力学重建自主力矩之间的残差推导得出。九名健康受试者完成了因子设计的目标高度-负荷试验以及疲劳前后水杯搬运任务。在无目标高度输入的情况下，门控方法在所有负荷条件下均生成了正确排序的低-中-高参考值：目标变化优先归因于轨迹自适应，而额外负荷则将自适应转向能力通道。该方法在全部九种条件下取得了最低的均方根误差（0.017弧度，相比之下，无门控双估计为0.041弧度，固定参考基于误差的AAN为0.127弧度）。疲劳后能力估计值下降，各高度下的辅助力度均增加，验证了其功能可行性。

Authors: Pengcheng Li, Shuxiang Guo, Hanze Wang, Jun Leng, Bin Wang, Mingchao Ding

MR-MPCC: Model Predictive Contouring Control for Robotic Manipulator Tracking under Moving Reference Frames Manipulation

Model Predictive Contouring Control moving reference frames path tracking robotic manipulation UR5e

简要说明：本文提出 MR-MPCC，一种用于机械臂的模型预测轮廓控制框架，通过优化路径进展并惩罚轮廓误差，在移动参考系下提高了路径跟踪性能，并在 UR5e 平台上进行了仿真验证。

TLDR: This paper introduces MR-MPCC, a Model Predictive Contouring Control framework for robotic manipulators that improves path tracking under moving reference frames by optimizing path progress and penalizing contouring errors, validated in simulation on a UR5e platform.

Abstract: Maintaining small path-tracking errors under moving reference frames is essential for robotic manipulation tasks with tight execution tolerances, such as machining and surgical automation. Conventional time-indexed controllers, including tracking Model Predictive Control (MPC), rely on a fixed temporal correspondence with the reference trajectory and may therefore accumulate path-relative error under abrupt reference-frame motion or timing mismatch. This paper presents MR-MPCC, a Model Predictive Contouring Control (MPCC) framework for velocity-controlled robotic manipulators with 6-DoF end-effector pose regulation under Moving-Reference disturbances. A hierarchical control architecture is adopted, in which an upper-level MPCC optimizes path progress while penalizing contouring and orientation errors, and a constrained resolved motion rate control (RMRC) layer maps the commanded Cartesian twist to feasible joint velocities under joint-level and safety constraints. MR-MPCC is implemented in a ROS2--MuJoCo pipeline and validated on a UR5e platform under moving-reference disturbances, where the path frame is perturbed and tracked by electromagnetic sensors. Compared with PI control and time-indexed tracking MPC under matched disturbance, MR-MPCC achieves lower geometric path-following error and smaller deviations in the moving path frame, demonstrating improved path-following performance under reference-frame motion.

摘要（中文）：移动参考系下保持较小的路径跟踪误差对于执行公差要求严格的机器人操作任务（如加工和手术自动化）至关重要。传统的时间索引控制器，包括跟踪模型预测控制（MPC），依赖于与参考轨迹的固定时间对应关系，因此在参考系突然运动或时间不匹配的情况下，可能会累积路径相对误差。本文提出了MR-MPCC，一种面向速度控制型机器人操作臂的模型预测轮廓控制（MPCC）框架，可在移动参考扰动下实现六自由度末端执行器位姿调节。采用分层控制架构，其中上层MPCC优化路径推进，同时惩罚轮廓误差和姿态误差；下层受约束的求解运动速率控制（RMRC）层将指令笛卡尔扭曲映射为满足关节级和安全约束的可行关节速度。MR-MPCC在ROS2–MuJoCo流水线中实现，并在UR5e平台上于移动参考扰动条件下进行验证，其中路径坐标系受到扰动并由电磁传感器跟踪。与匹配扰动下的PI控制和时间索引跟踪MPC相比，MR-MPCC在移动路径坐标系中实现了更低的几何路径跟踪误差和更小的偏差，展示了在参考系运动下更优的路径跟踪性能。

Authors: Chonghao Cheng, Tiancheng Li, Jonathan Woolfrey, Liang Zhao, Shoudong Huang

LICOA: Learning Instruction-Conditioned Optical Actions for Mobile Spatial Augmented Reality VLA

spatial augmented reality language-conditioned action embodied action steerable mirror sim-to-real

简要说明：LICOA 提出了一种移动式空间增强现实系统，将投影光视为具身动作，通过差速底盘和可操控镜面，由语言条件动作模型控制，并在仿真中训练后部署到真实机器人上。

TLDR: LICOA introduces a mobile spatial augmented reality system that treats projected light as an embodied action, using a differential-drive chassis and steerable mirror controlled by a language-conditioned action model trained in simulation and deployed on a real robot.

Abstract: Spatial augmented reality (SAR) augments physical environments with projected content, but most systems assume that the projector pose, target region, or motion path has been fixed or specified. We instead make projected light an embodied action: given a language instruction and current visual observations, a system must decide how to move and where and at what scale to place the projection. We introduce LICOA to realize this capability. Its differential-drive chassis provides room-scale approach and repositioning, while a steerable mirror with two degrees of freedom (2DoF) and projection scale provide rapid local control of the beam. A shared interface maps synchronized external and onboard RGB cameras with robot control state to physical optical actions across pretrained action models. Because instruction-conditioned optical action lacks dedicated training data and a common evaluation protocol, we construct a matched simulation embodiment and a corpus with 150 tasks and 7,500 rendered episodes, then evaluate models trained only on this corpus in previously unseen real-world environments. Across 480 complete closed-loop real-world execution trials (rollouts) on 12 tasks, the best adapted action model achieves a 57.50% success rate and 40.64% success weighted by path length, compared with 8.33% and 5.15% for the same architecture trained from scratch. A further 150 real-world ablation rollouts support the need for both camera views and coordinated control of the chassis and mirror. These results establish a physical platform, shared perception and optical action interface, corpus, and real-world evaluation protocol for treating projected light as an embodied action.

摘要（中文）：空间增强现实（SAR）通过投影内容增强物理环境，但大多数系统假设投影仪位姿、目标区域或运动路径已固定或预先指定。我们转而将投影光视为一种具身动作：给定语言指令和当前视觉观察，系统必须决定如何移动、投影到何处以及以何种尺度进行投影。我们引入LICOA来实现这一能力。其差速驱动底盘支持房间尺度的接近与重新定位，而具有两个自由度（2DoF）的转向镜和投影尺度则提供光束的快速局部控制。共享接口将同步的外部与机载RGB相机及机器人控制状态映射到预训练动作模型上的物理光学动作中。由于指令条件化的光学动作缺乏专门的训练数据和统一的评估协议，我们构建了一个匹配的仿真具身环境以及包含150个任务和7，500个渲染片段的语料库，然后仅在此语料库上训练模型，并在未见过的真实世界环境中进行评估。在12个任务的480次完整闭环真实世界执行试验（rollouts）中，最优适配动作模型实现了57.50%的成功率和40.64%的按路径长度加权成功率，而相同架构从头训练的结果分别为8.33%和5.15%。进一步的150次真实世界消融试验支持了双相机视角以及底盘与转向镜协调控制的必要性。这些结果建立了一个物理平台、共享感知与光学动作接口、语料库以及真实世界评估协议，从而将投影光视为一种具身动作。

Authors: Yuchen Deng, Shunkai Zhou, Ruixuan Zhu, Haibin Ling, Bingyao Huang

CLIS-MPPI: Closed-Loop Model Predictive Path Integral Control With Initial-State Sampling Under Execution Delay Manipulation

Model Predictive Path Integral Initial-State Sampling Execution Delay Closed-Loop Control Real Robot Manipulation

简要说明：通过初始状态采样显式处理执行延迟的闭环MPPI方法，提高了真实机械臂任务的安全性和规划一致性。

TLDR: Closed-loop MPPI with initial-state sampling explicitly handles execution delays in robotic motion planning, improving safety and consistency on a real 6-DoF manipulator.

Abstract: Sampling-based motion planning such as Model Predictive Path Integral (MPPI) control has become attractive for robotics due to its ability to handle nonlinear dynamics and non-smooth objectives without gradient information, while leveraging parallel rollout computation for real-time performance. However, in real-world robotic systems, the optimized control input is often applied after a non-negligible planning delay, causing a mismatch between the state used in forward simulation and the actual state at control execution, which can significantly degrade planning accuracy and may even lead to unsafe behavior such as collisions. This paper proposes Closed-Loop MPPI with Initial-State Sampling (CLIS-MPPI), which explicitly addresses execution-time state mismatch by modeling planning delay as a distribution over plausible execution-time initial states, performing rollout optimization from sampled initial states, and applying a rollout-based local feedback correction during control execution. The proposed method is validated through real-world experiments on a 6-DoF UR5e manipulator in a narrow-passage task involving obstacle avoidance and end-effector target reaching. Across 5 real-world runs of the same task, standard MPPI collided in 2 runs, whereas CLIS-MPPI remained collision-free in all 5 runs. Averaged over all collision-free runs for each method (3 for MPPI and 5 for CLIS-MPPI), CLIS-MPPI reduced the average task completion time from 25.4s to 24.4s and the average end-effector path length from 0.456 m to 0.425 m. It also reduced the overall joint-position and joint-velocity root mean square errors (RMSEs) from 0.100 rad and 0.108 rad/s to 0.017 rad and 0.011 rad/s, respectively. These results demonstrate improved safety, planning-execution consistency, and motion smoothness.

摘要（中文）：基于采样的运动规划方法，例如模型预测路径积分（MPPI）控制，因其能够处理非线性动力学和非光滑目标函数而无需梯度信息，同时利用并行 rollout 计算实现实时性能，已在机器人领域展现出显著吸引力。然而，在实际机器人系统中，优化后的控制输入往往在经历不可忽略的规划延迟后才被执行，导致前向仿真中使用的状态与控制执行时的实际状态之间存在失配，这可能严重降低规划精度，甚至引发碰撞等不安全行为。本文提出了一种闭环 MPPI 方法——初始状态采样的闭环 MPPI（CLIS-MPPI），通过将规划延迟建模为关于可能的执行时初始状态的分布，从采样的初始状态出发执行 rollout 优化，并在控制执行过程中应用基于 rollout 的局部反馈修正，从而显式地解决执行时状态失配问题。所提方法在 6 自由度 UR5e 机械臂上进行了真实世界实验验证，任务为包含避障和末端执行器目标到达的狭窄通道作业。在相同任务的 5 次真实运行中，标准 MPPI 方法有 2 次发生碰撞，而 CLIS-MPPI 方法在全部 5 次运行中均保持无碰撞。对每种方法的所有无碰撞运行取平均（MPPI 为 3 次，CLIS-MPPI 为 5 次），CLIS-MPPI 将平均任务完成时间从 25.4 秒缩短至 24.4 秒，平均末端执行器路径长度从 0.456 米缩短至 0.425 米。同时，其将整体关节位置和关节速度的均方根误差（RMSE）分别从 0.100 弧度 和 0.108 弧度/秒 降低至 0.017 弧度 和 0.011 弧度/秒。这些结果验证了该方法在安全性、规划-执行一致性以及运动平滑性方面的显著提升。

Authors: Zidong Liu, Xu Chen

LIN-SLAM: Lightweight LiDAR--Inertial Neural SLAM for Real-Time Onboard Navigation Locomotion

LiDAR-inertial SLAM neural implicit mapping real-time onboard state estimation global refinement

简要说明：LIN-SLAM是一种混合激光雷达-惯性SLAM系统，结合了几何状态估计与神经隐式建图和全局优化，在移动机器人上实现了实时机载操作并达到最先进的精度。

TLDR: LIN-SLAM is a hybrid LiDAR-inertial SLAM system combining geometric state estimation with neural implicit mapping and global refinement, achieving real-time onboard operation on a mobile robot with state-of-the-art accuracy.

Abstract: Geometric light detection and ranging (LiDAR)--inertial simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM) provides efficient state estimation but lacks the continuous map representation and global refinement capabilities of neural implicit SLAM, while neural implicit methods remain computationally expensive. We propose Lightweight LiDAR--Inertial Neural SLAM (LIN-SLAM), a hybrid method that couples high-rate geometric LiDAR--inertial estimation with neural implicit tracking, continual mapping, and global refinement for accurate real-time onboard SLAM. Experiments on twelve representative sequences from three datasets spanning 32-, 64-, and 128-channel LiDAR configurations show that LIN-SLAM achieves the lowest overall mean absolute trajectory error (ATE) among the evaluated state-of-the-art geometric and neural implicit methods, while substantially reducing runtime compared with existing neural implicit SLAM methods. On a Unitree Go2 equipped with an NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX and a 16-channel LiDAR, LIN-SLAM sustains real-time localization and neural mapping over a 1.47-km indoor trajectory through challenging repetitive corridor environments, with an endpoint closure error of only 0.141~m. To the best of our knowledge, LIN-SLAM is the first LiDAR--inertial SLAM system with a neural implicit backend to achieve real-time online operation on a mobile robotic platform while maintaining state-of-the-art localization accuracy. The code will be released upon acceptance.

摘要（中文）：几何激光雷达-惯性同步定位与建图（SLAM）提供高效的状态估计，但缺乏神经隐式SLAM所具备的连续地图表示和全局优化能力，而神经隐式方法计算成本高昂。我们提出轻量级激光雷达-惯性神经SLAM（LIN-SLAM），这是一种将高频率几何激光雷达-惯性估计与神经隐式跟踪、连续建图和全局优化相结合的混合方法，可实现精确的实时机载SLAM。在涵盖32、64和128线激光雷达配置的三个数据集、十二个代表性序列上的实验表明，LIN-SLAM在所评估的最新几何方法和神经隐式方法中实现了最低的总体平均绝对轨迹误差（ATE），同时相较于现有神经隐式SLAM方法大幅降低了运行时间。在搭载NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX和16线激光雷达的Unitree Go2上，LIN-SLAM在具有挑战性的重复走廊环境中，沿1.47公里室内轨迹维持实时定位和神经建图，终点闭合误差仅为0.141米。据我们所知，LIN-SLAM是首个在移动机器人平台上实现实时在线运行、同时保持最先进定位精度的具有神经隐式后端的激光雷达-惯性SLAM系统。代码将在论文被接收后公开。

Authors: Shiqi Che, Yijie Liu, Shuo Wang, Wenxin Liu

Evo-DexBench: Benchmarking Generalization across Related Tasks for Dexterous Manipulation Manipulation

dexterous manipulation benchmark generalization simulated Shadow Hands VR teleoperation

简要说明：Evo-DexBench 提出了一个用于灵巧操作泛化的基准，通过控制源任务相关性和限制目标任务演示，发现联合 Core+Gen 训练优于顺序微调。

TLDR: Evo-DexBench introduces a benchmark for dexterous manipulation generalization with controlled source-task relatedness and limited target demonstrations, using simulated Shadow Hands and VR teleoperation, and finds that joint Core+Gen training outperforms sequential fine-tuning.

Abstract: General-purpose dexterous manipulation requires policies to transfer knowledge from related tasks to new tasks with only a few target demonstrations. Existing benchmarks often provide too many target demonstrations. They also leave the differences between source and target tasks uncontrolled. As a result, they cannot clearly distinguish knowledge transfer from task memorization. Our key insight is the Core-Gen principle. Core tasks are related tasks that share a functional interaction and provide source knowledge, while a Gen task is a novel target within the same functional family that has only a few demonstrations. This setup tests whether a policy can reuse functional interaction knowledge. Based on this principle, we propose Evo-DexBench, which controls both source-task relatedness and target-task exposure. It comprises 30 tasks in six functional families and a VR teleoperation pipeline. The resulting dataset covers three everyday scenes per task. It contains 1,248 multimodal demonstrations collected with simulated Shadow Hands equipped with 123 taxels. Experiments show that even the best-performing method achieves an average success rate of only 38.5%, highlighting the challenges existing methods face in transferring functional interaction knowledge. Further analysis shows that, across the two tasks, joint Core+Gen training improves performance by 12% and 38%, respectively, over training on Core followed by fine-tuning on Gen. This indicates that joint training makes better use of Core knowledge and that functionally matched Core data yields greater gains in success rate than mismatched data. We release the Evo-DexBench dataset and benchmark to support the evaluation of dexterous manipulation policies' generalization across related tasks.

摘要（中文）：通用灵巧操作要求策略能够仅凭借少量目标演示，将知识从相关任务迁移到新任务中。现有基准往往提供了过多的目标演示，并且未能对源任务与目标任务之间的差异进行有效控制，因此难以清晰地区分知识迁移与任务记忆化。我们的关键洞察在于“核心-生成”（Core-Gen）原则。核心任务是指共享某种功能性交互并提供源知识的相关任务，而生成任务（Gen task）则是同一功能族内仅具备少量演示的新目标任务。这种设置用于检验策略是否能够复用功能性交互知识。基于该原则，我们提出了Evo-DexBench，该基准同时控制源任务相关性和目标任务暴露程度，包含六个功能族中的30个任务以及一套VR遥操作流程。生成的数据集覆盖每个任务的三个日常场景，包含1,248条多模态演示，这些演示由配备123个触觉传感器的仿真Shadow Hand采集。实验结果表明，即使性能最佳的方法，其平均成功率也仅为38.5%，这凸显了现有方法在迁移功能性交互知识方面所面临的挑战。进一步分析显示，在这两个任务中，联合“核心+生成”训练相对于先在核心任务上训练再在生成任务上进行微调的方法，性能分别提升了12%和38%。这表明联合训练能更有效地利用核心知识，且功能匹配的核心数据比不匹配的数据能带来更大的成功率提升。我们公开了Evo-DexBench数据集和基准，以支持灵巧操作策略在相关任务间泛化能力的评估。

Authors: Bing Cheng, Yiran Mao, Zewei Ye, Yifan Jin, Xinyi Chen, Ruifeng Tu, Shuhuai Wang, Tao Lin, Zhimu Zhou, Yuxin Du, Fangwei Zhong, Junchi Yan, Bo Zhao

Manifold Generative Annealing for Contact Constraint-aware Impedance Control with Reinforcement Learning Prior Manipulation

impedance control reinforcement learning prior model-based rollouts manifold refinement contact-rich manipulation

简要说明：本文提出流形生成退火（MGA），一种结合无模型与基于模型的生成框架，利用强化学习先验和基于模型的滚动优化及流形细化，用于接触约束阻抗控制，在表面扫描、插销和人形推挤任务中提高了安全成功率。

TLDR: This paper introduces Manifold Generative Annealing (MGA), a hybrid model-free and model-based generative framework that combines reinforcement learning priors with model-based rollouts and manifold refinement for contact-constrained impedance control, improving safety success rates on surface scanning, peg insertion, and humanoid pushing tasks.

Abstract: Contact-rich robotic tasks require coordinated motion and impedance under uncertain interaction dynamics and physical constraints. While recent methods on learned policies provide useful interaction strategies, they may fail when contact conditions differ from those encountered during training. Model-based generative methods show promising receding-horizon trajectories optimization results, but often lack structured behavioral guidance and refinement that jointly accounts for constraint geometry and actual contact responses. To this end, we propose Manifold Generative Annealing (MGA), a joint model-free and model-based generative framework for motion--impedance optimization. MGA first organizes pretrained reinforcement learning policies into structured sequence proposals, retaining task-specific interaction strategies without committing to their execution. It then evaluates these proposals alongside exploratory samples through model-based rollouts for refinement or separate execution selection. Crucially, realization-aware manifold refinement aligns updates from the refinement bank with both task constraints and locally achievable physical responses, allowing learned experience to guide online adaptation under changing contact conditions. Experiments cover surface scanning, peg insertion, and humanoid pushing, with improved safety success rate of impedance control under nominal and sensing-shift conditions.

摘要（中文）：接触丰富的机器人任务要求在不确定的交互动力学和物理约束下实现协调运动与阻抗控制。尽管近期基于学习策略的方法提供了有用的交互策略，但当接触条件与训练时遇到的情况不同时，这些方法可能会失效。基于模型的生成方法在滚动时域轨迹优化方面展现了良好效果，但往往缺乏能同时考虑约束几何和实际接触响应的结构化行为引导与细化机制。为此，我们提出流形生成退火（MGA）方法，这是一种无模型与基于模型相结合的生成框架，用于运动-阻抗联合优化。MGA首先将预训练的强化学习策略组织为结构化序列提议，保留任务特定的交互策略而不直接执行这些策略。随后，它通过基于模型的滚动评估这些提议及探索性样本，以进行细化或选择单独执行。关键在于，可实现性感知的流形细化将细化库中的更新与任务约束及局部可实现的物理响应相对齐，使学习经验能够在变化的接触条件下指导在线自适应。实验涵盖表面扫描、销钉插入和人形机器人推搡任务，在标称条件和传感偏移条件下，阻抗控制的安全成功率均有所提升。

Authors: Zhilin He, Guoquan Qi, Changliu Liu

RoPE-Flow: Monocular Vision-based Robot Pose Estimation via 2D Graph-Conditioned 3D Flow Matching Perception3D

robot pose estimation flow matching graph-conditioned monocular vision cross-scene benchmark

简要说明：RoPE-Flow 提出了一种基于 flow matching 的单目相机到机器人姿态估计框架，通过关键点中心特征提取、图引导条件和逐关节损失，实现了最先进的精度和跨场景零样本泛化。

TLDR: RoPE-Flow proposes an end-to-end flow matching framework for monocular camera-to-robot pose estimation, using keypoint-centered feature extraction, graph-guided conditioning, and joint-wise losses to achieve state-of-the-art accuracy and zero-shot cross-scene generalization.

Abstract: Camera-to-robot pose estimation from a monocular image is significant for vision-based robot navigation and control. However, recovering 3D structural features from 2D observations remains a challenging task. Existing camera-to-robot pose estimation methods either rely on time-consuming iterative rendering or involve sophisticated 2D-3D registration which suffers from projection ambiguity, accumulated errors for distal joints and imbalanced learning for different joints. In this work, we propose RoPE-Flow, an end-to-end flow matching-based framework for camera-to-robot pose estimation. From the predicted 2D heatmaps, we propose a Keypoint-centered Feature Extractor to obtain positional features along with contextual representations from keypoints-centered multi-scale patches. Moreover, we introduce Graph-guided Condition Generator, which embeds a learnable adjacency map to generate condition for flow matching based on correlation among keypoints. Besides, we introduce Bone Length Loss and Ray-Depth Loss for topological consistency and scale stability, with joint-wise weighting to mitigate varied prediction difficulty across joints. The proposed method outperforms state-of-the-art methods for pose estimation across different types of robots with mutiple cameras. Besides, we establish a novel cross-scene benchmark to demonstrate the outstanding performance of RoPE-Flow on zero-shot cross-scene robot pose estimation. Meanwhile, animated visualizations are shown on the website: ropeflow.netlify.app

摘要（中文）：从单目图像估计相机到机器人的位姿对于基于视觉的机器人导航与控制具有重要意义。然而，从二维观测中恢复三维结构特征仍是一项具有挑战性的任务。现有的相机到机器人位姿估计方法要么依赖耗时的迭代渲染，要么涉及复杂的二维-三维配准，后者存在投影模糊、远端关节误差累积以及不同关节学习不均衡等问题。在本工作中，我们提出了RoPE-Flow，一种基于流匹配的端到端框架，用于相机到机器人位姿估计。基于预测的二维热图，我们提出了一种以关键点为中心的特征提取器，从以关键点为中心的多尺度图像块中获取位置特征及上下文表示。此外，我们引入了图引导条件生成器，该生成器嵌入一个可学习的邻接图，根据关键点之间的相关性生成流匹配的条件。同时，我们引入了骨骼长度损失和射线深度损失，以保证拓扑一致性和尺度稳定性，并采用逐关节加权方式以缓解不同关节预测难度差异带来的问题。所提出的方法在多种机器人类型和多相机设置下的位姿估计中均优于现有最先进方法。此外，我们建立了一个新颖的跨场景基准，以验证RoPE-Flow在零样本跨场景机器人位姿估计中的优异性能。同时，动画可视化展示见网站：ropeflow.netlify.app。

Authors: Liangjing Shao, Wanhao Liu, Zhiwei Fang, Rulin Zhou, Quanlu Zhang, Changjing Liu, Beilei Cui, Yiming Huang, Hongliang Ren

When a robot can trust reversing wind to find an odour source Locomotion

wind-guided search odour source localization quadruped robot reversing wind plume transport

简要说明：本文研究了四足机器人在风场中通过风向引导定位气味源的问题，证明了即使风向反转，基于风向的航向也能可靠地引导机器人到达源，并给出了航向正确性与净气味输送之间的几何条件。

TLDR: This paper studies wind-guided odor source localization for a quadruped robot, showing that a heading based on wind direction can reliably guide the robot to the source even under reversing winds, and providing a geometric condition linking heading correctness to net odour transport.

Abstract: A wind-derived heading can guide a robot towards an odour source even after the wind reverses, but its reliability depends on the plume's transport history. On a quadruped initially facing the source, holding the initial heading reached it in every reversing-wind trial, whereas comparison controllers never settled there. An exact geometric condition links heading correctness to net odour transport, and simulations separate sensing error from departures from nominal flow. Where the alternating wind directions are too close for reversal alone to produce wrong-side headings, the wrong-side rate rises from 1.0% under uniform transport to 4.7% in a stochastic flow. Re-acquiring headings from new odour contact improves simulated search when contact is intermittent. These results identify distinct requirements for wind-guided search: a heading supported by the transport geometry and sufficient intermittent contact to replace it.

摘要（中文）：风向衍生的航向即使在风向逆转后也能引导机器人趋向气味源，但其可靠性取决于羽流的传输历史。在一台初始朝向气味源的四足机器人上，保持初始航向在每次风向逆转试验中均能到达目标，而对比控制器从未稳定在其附近。一个精确的几何条件将航向正确性与气味净传输联系起来，模拟实验则能将传感误差与偏离标称流动的情况区分开来。当交替风向过于接近，仅靠反转无法产生错误侧航向时，错误侧发生率从均匀传输下的1.0%上升至随机流场中的4.7%。在接触间歇的情况下，通过新的气味接触重新获取航向可改善模拟搜索效果。这些结果揭示了风引导搜索的不同要求：一个由传输几何支持的航向，以及足以替换该航向的间歇性接触。

Authors: Junlong Shen, Shunsuke Shigaki

SOMA: Stack-of-Objects Manipulation using a Quadruped Robot RLRobot

hierarchical reinforcement learning non-prehensile manipulation quadruped robot sim-to-real transfer base-height control

简要说明：SOMA 提出了一种用于四足机器人全身非抓取操作物体堆叠的分层强化学习框架，通过显式基座高度控制，并在 Unitree Go1 上实现了 sim-to-real 迁移。

TLDR: SOMA presents a hierarchical reinforcement learning framework for whole-body non-prehensile manipulation of object stacks with a quadruped robot, using explicit base-height control and sim-to-real transfer on a Unitree Go1.

Abstract: Executing heavy-duty physical manipulation in unpredictable environments remains a major challenge for quadrupedal robots lacking dedicated manipulators. This paper presents SOMA, a hierarchical reinforcement learning framework for whole-body non-prehensile manipulation of multi-object stacks using a quadruped robot. Unlike traditional methods restricted to two-dimensional planar pushing, SOMA integrates explicit robot base-height control, unlocking full three-dimensional pushing strategies. This capability enables the quadruped to manipulate complex payload stacks as a unified system while preventing relative sliding or tipping of upper layers. The architecture factorizes control into a high-level manipulation policy using a Simplified Structured State Space Sequence (S5) encoder to reason over long-horizon temporal history and predict bounded target tracking commands via Beta distributions, and a low-level locomotion policy that dynamically adapts leg stance configurations. In extensive simulation benchmarks, SOMA achieves a $90.3\%$ success rate for single-object reposing and up to $90.1\%$ for dynamic two-box stacks under stringent error margins ($0.05\text{ m}$ position error, $1^\circ$ orientation error). Finally, we validate zero-shot sim-to-real transfer on a Unitree Go1 quadruped robot across diverse payload masses and geometries, demonstrating active base-height adjustments to maintain traction and balance during heavy pushing tasks.

摘要（中文）：在执行重载荷物理操作于不可预测环境中，对于缺乏专用机械臂的四足机器人而言，仍是一项重大挑战。本文介绍了SOMA，一种面向四足机器人多物体堆栈全身非抓取操作的分层强化学习框架。与局限于二维平面推动的传统方法不同，SOMA融合了显式的机器人基座高度控制，解锁了完整的三维推动策略。这一能力使四足机器人能够将复杂载荷堆栈作为统一系统进行操作，同时防止上层物体的相对滑动或倾覆。该架构将控制分解为高层操作策略与低层运动策略：高层策略采用简化结构化状态空间序列（S5）编码器，推理长时间跨度的时序历史，并通过Beta分布预测有界目标跟踪指令；低层策略则动态调整腿部站立姿态配置。在广泛的仿真基准测试中，SOMA在严格的误差容限（位置误差$0.05\text{ m}$，方向误差$1^\circ$）下，实现了单物体重定位$90.3\%$的成功率，以及动态双箱堆栈高达$90.1\%$的成功率。最后，我们在Unitree Go1四足机器人上验证了零样本仿真到实物的迁移，涵盖多种载荷质量与几何形状，展示了在执行重载推动任务时主动调整基座高度以维持牵引力与平衡的能力。

Authors: Stergios E. Bachoumas, Panagiotis Artemiadis

Planning to Learn: Real-Time Robust Adaptive Control on the GPU with Guaranteed Future Learning RLRobot

robust adaptive control model predictive control system-level synthesis GPU-accelerated quadruped

简要说明：本文提出A-SLS，一个基于GPU加速的学习感知鲁棒自适应模型预测控制框架，通过预测未来参数不确定性来构建更紧的可达集，并在物理Crazyflie无人机和模拟四足机器人上验证。

TLDR: This paper presents A-SLS, a GPU-accelerated learning-aware robust adaptive model predictive control framework that forecasts future parameter uncertainty to construct tighter reachable sets, demonstrated on a physical Crazyflie drone and simulated quadruped.

Abstract: Robust adaptive control is vital for keeping robots safe while actively reducing uncertainty in unfamiliar settings. However, traditional methods are often conservative since they fail to account for guaranteed future parameter learning during planning and struggle to scale to high-dimensional systems. In this work, we present A-SLS, a learning-aware robust adaptive model predictive control (RAMPC) framework based on system-level synthesis. A-SLS forecasts future parameter uncertainty and preserves correlations between process disturbances, parameter error, and estimate updates to construct tight, guaranteed reachable sets that account for future information gain. We also develop a GPU-accelerated A-SLS solver to enable real-time performance. Across nonlinear robotic systems, A-SLS reduces reachable-tube conservativeness, maintains real-time performance, and scales to whole-body control for a quadruped with 61 states, 8 uncertain parameters, and 12 control inputs. We further demonstrate the approach on hardware, where a physical Crazyflie drone learns an uncertain dynamics parameter online to stabilize on the fly.

摘要（中文）：鲁棒自适应控制对于在陌生环境中保障机器人安全并主动降低不确定性至关重要。然而，传统方法往往较为保守，因为它们在规划过程中未能考虑未来参数学习的保证效果，且难以扩展到高维系统。在本研究中，我们提出了A-SLS，一种基于系统级综合的学习感知鲁棒自适应模型预测控制（RAMPC）框架。A-SLS预测未来参数不确定性，并保留过程扰动、参数误差与估计更新之间的相关性，从而构建考虑未来信息增益的紧凑且保证的可达集。我们还开发了GPU加速的A-SLS求解器，以实现实时性能。在非线性机器人系统中，A-SLS降低了可达管道的保守性，保持了实时性能，并扩展到具有61个状态、8个不确定参数和12个控制输入的四足机器人全身控制。我们进一步在硬件上验证了该方法，其中物理Crazyflie无人机在线学习不确定动力学参数，以实现飞行中的稳定控制。

Authors: Anutam Srinivasan, Siddhant Panse, Glen Chou

BubbleCBF: Constructive Safety for Second-Order Systems and Application to Autonomous Robot Navigation in Unknown Environments Other

control barrier functions safety filter autonomous navigation signed distance function differential-drive robot

简要说明：本文提出了BubbleCBF，一种为二阶控制仿射系统设计可行安全约束的构造性方法，并将其应用于差分驱动机器人在未知环境中的安全自主导航。

TLDR: This paper introduces BubbleCBF, a constructive method for designing feasible safety constraints for second-order control-affine systems using signed distance functions, and demonstrates its application to safe autonomous navigation of a differential-drive robot in unknown environments.

Abstract: Satisfying safety constraints for systems with second-order dynamics is challenging because a position constraint may require infeasible deceleration. Higher-order control barrier functions (CBFs) provide an approach for expressing safety conditions for such systems but feasibility depends on the system dynamics and available control authority. We develop a constructive approach for designing feasible safety constraints for second-order control-affine systems. Starting from a signed distance function (SDF), we construct collision-free spheres, i.e., bubbles, in position space, and use their quadratic geometry and overlap to construct a velocity-dependent safety constraint. The associated safe set is represented as a union of intersections and enforced through a quadratic-program safety filter. Under mild assumptions on the dynamics, bubble overlap, and design parameters, we prove that the quadratic-program-based controller is well defined, continuous in the system state, and renders the set forward invariant. We also derive sufficient conditions for feasibility under bounded inputs. We demonstrate that our BubbleCBF, applied to a differential-drive robot, achieves safe autonomous navigation in unknown environments. Videos and results are available at: https://existentialrobotics.org/bubblecbf/.

摘要（中文）：满足二阶动力学系统的安全约束具有挑战性，因为位置约束可能需要不可行的减速度。高阶控制屏障函数（CBFs）为表达此类系统的安全条件提供了一种方法，但其可行性取决于系统动力学和可用的控制权限。我们开发了一种构造性方法，用于为二阶控制仿射系统设计可行的安全约束。从符号距离函数（SDF）出发，我们在位置空间中构造无碰撞球体，即气泡，并利用其二次几何性质和重叠关系构造依赖于速度的安全约束。相应的安全集表示为交集的并集，并通过二次规划安全滤波器强制执行。在关于动力学、气泡重叠和设计参数的温和假设下，我们证明了基于二次规划的控制器是良定义的、关于系统状态连续的，并且使该集合保持前向不变。我们还推导了在有界输入下可行性的充分条件。我们展示了将我们的BubbleCBF应用于差速驱动机器人，能够在未知环境中实现安全自主导航。视频和结果可在以下网址获取：https://existentialrobotics.org/bubblecbf/。

Authors: Mani Amani, Mohammed Alyaseen, Zhirui Dai, Ki Myung Brian Lee, Nikolay Atanasov, Jorge Cortes

Clarity-Driven Adaptive Mission Planning for a Solar-Powered Autonomous Surface Vessel Other

adaptive mission planning ergodic search clarity autonomous surface vessel solar-powered

简要说明：本文提出了一种针对太阳能自主水面艇的清晰度驱动自适应任务规划策略，利用遍历搜索和在线重规划在可再生能源约束下优先访问信息丰富区域，并通过仿真和Jordan Lake现场实验验证。

TLDR: This paper presents a clarity-driven adaptive mission planning strategy for solar-powered autonomous surface vessels, using ergodic search and online re-planning to prioritize information-rich locations under renewable energy constraints, validated in simulations and field experiments at Jordan Lake.

Abstract: This paper presents a comprehensive methodology, backed by simulation and experimental results, for an adaptive mission planning strategy that is mathematically grounded in the maximization of the information-driven quantity of clarity. In particular, the methodology introduced in this work addresses the use of sustainably powered autonomous surface vessels (ASVs) to perform scientific missions that prioritize locations of maximum interest. Because these locations of maximum interest are not known a priori but are rather identified based on in-situ measurements, online adaptation is essential for mission planning. Furthermore, the reliance on a limited-power renewable resource requires an adaptation strategy that maximizes information gathering subject to mobility restrictions imposed by the renewable resource. Our approach addresses these challenges through a clarity-driven ergodic search, where clarity represents a mathematical quantity that has been rigorously linked to differential (information) entropy. In our approach, a target clarity map is adapted online to reflect the prioritization of certain areas based on in-situ measurements, and an ergodic path planner continually re-plans based on the target clarity map and ASV speed limitations (driven by the renewable propulsion source). Focusing on a solar-powered ASV, we present simulations and experiments conducted at Jordan Lake, North Carolina, demonstrating the effectiveness of the proposed approach.

摘要（中文）：本文提出了一种综合方法，并辅以仿真与实验验证，其基础是一种以信息驱动清晰度最大化原则为数学依据的自适应任务规划策略。具体而言，本文所述方法着眼于利用可持续能源驱动的自主水面艇（ASVs）执行科学任务，并优先关注兴趣度最高的区域。由于这些高兴趣区域并非先验已知，而是依据现场测量结果实时判别，因此任务规划中的在线自适应调整至关重要。此外，由于依赖功率有限的可再生能源，所采用的调整策略需在可再生能源带来的移动限制条件下，尽可能最大化信息采集量。我们通过一种以清晰度驱动的遍历搜索方法应对上述挑战，其中清晰度是一个与微分（信息）熵严密相关的数学量。在该方法中，目标清晰度图在线调整，以依据现场测量反映对特定区域的优先级划分；同时，遍历路径规划器根据目标清晰度图及由可再生能源推进系统所决定的自主水面艇速度限制，持续进行路径重规划。本文以太阳能驱动的自主水面艇为对象，展示了在北卡罗来纳州乔丹湖开展的仿真与实验结果，验证了所提方法的有效性。

Authors: Kavin M. Govindarajan, Kaleb Ben Naveed, David Li, Devansh R. Agrawal, Mary Maceda, Matthew Bryant, Dimitra Panagou, Chris Vermillion

Persistent Profile-Guided Reset-Free Recovery Improves Final Gait Selection after Irreversible Leg Damage Locomotion

reset-free recovery uncertainty-aware gait selection damage recovery MuJoCo

简要说明：本文提出PGRR，一种基于保守不确定性估计的无重置损伤恢复算法，通过在线引导步态探索，在不可逆腿部损伤模拟中提升最终步态选择质量。

TLDR: The paper presents PGRR, an uncertainty-aware reset-free damage recovery algorithm that guides online gait probes to improve final gait selection under irreversible leg damage in simulated robots.

Abstract: Damage-recovery algorithms often rank gaits from short trials, yet a gait that performs well briefly may not remain effective during continued execution. In reset-free recovery, each trial also changes the physical state inherited by the next. We introduce persistent profile-guided reset-free recovery (PGRR), which predicts multiple outcomes over repeated gait execution and uses conservative uncertainty-aware estimates to guide short online probes without resetting the robot. Across 108 matched MuJoCo tasks spanning leg amputation, distal fracture, and joint lock, PGRR improves final quality by 0.106 and slot-averaged recovery quality (SRQ) by 0.044 relative to an IT&E-inspired Gaussian-process baseline, while reducing low-quality failures by 27.8 percentage points. Final-quality gains occur in all three damage classes. Against no adaptation, PGRR also improves final quality and reduces low-quality failures, whereas the aggregate SRQ difference is inconclusive. Development ablations identify conservative uncertainty handling as the clearest supported contributor to the observed gains. These results show that PGRR can identify stronger post-damage gaits under continuous physical state and that final-gait quality and recovery-summary performance provide complementary evidence for evaluating reset-free recovery.

摘要（中文）：损伤恢复算法通常基于短时试验来对步态进行排序，然而，一种在短时间内表现良好的步态，在持续执行过程中未必依然有效。在无重置恢复中，每次试验还会改变下一次试验所继承的物理状态。我们提出了一种持久型轮廓引导的无重置恢复方法（PGRR），该方法能够预测重复步态执行过程中的多种结果，并利用保守的不确定性感知估计来指导短时在线探测，而无需重置机器人。在涵盖截肢、远端骨折和关节锁定三类损伤的108项匹配MuJoCo任务中，与基于IT&E启发的高斯过程基线相比，PGRR在最终质量上提升了0.106，在时段平均恢复质量（SRQ）上提升了0.044，同时将低质量失败率降低了27.8个百分点。最终质量的提升在全部三类损伤中均有所体现。与不进行适应相比，PGRR同样在最终质量和低质量失败率方面有所改善，但总体SRQ差异尚不明确。消融实验分析表明，保守的不确定性处理是所观察到的性能提升中最明确的支持性因素。上述结果表明，PGRR能够在持续物理状态下识别出更优的损伤后步态，且最终步态质量与恢复摘要性能可为无重置恢复的评估提供互补性证据。

Authors: Minjoong Kim

Navigation by Skylight Polarization via Rayleigh Model Optimization on a Road Vehicle AutonomousDriving

skylight polarization heading estimation Rayleigh model road vehicle polarimetric camera

简要说明：本文提出一种基于天空偏振光的车辆导航方法，通过全局优化瑞利天空模型与偏振相机测量值来估计航向，在多个城市道路轨迹上达到亚度级均方根偏航误差，并优于现有方法。

TLDR: This paper presents a skylight polarization navigation method for road vehicles that estimates heading by globally optimizing a Rayleigh sky model against polarimetric camera measurements, achieving sub-degree RMS yaw error and improved robustness over existing methods.

Abstract: Reliable absolute heading estimation is critical for road-vehicle navigation, particularly when magnetic, inertial, or GNSS-based references are degraded. This paper presents a skylight polarization navigation method that estimates vehicle heading by globally optimizing a Rayleigh sky model against measurements from a division-of-focal-plane polarimetric camera. The proposed framework combines a pinhole camera model, a single-scattering Rayleigh polarization model, and a solar position algorithm to synthesize the expected full image angle of polarization distribution for candidate vehicle states. A degree of polarization weighted root mean square error objective function compares measured and simulated polarization patterns, allowing the estimator to use all available sky information while attenuating low confidence pixels caused by clouds, buildings, foliage, and other depolarizing occlusions. Experimental evaluation is performed using three urban road vehicle trajectories collected with a roof mounted polarimetric camera and a high precision dual-antenna GNSS/INS reference system. Results show sub-degree RMS yaw error across all trajectories, ranging from $0.718^{\circ}$ to $0.889^{\circ}$. Compared with representative feature-based and model-based polarization navigation methods, the proposed approach reduces RMS heading error by up to 87% and demonstrates improved robustness to partial sky occlusion.

摘要（中文）：可靠的绝对航向估计对于道路车辆导航至关重要，尤其是在地磁、惯性或基于GNSS的参考信息受到干扰时。本文提出了一种天光偏振导航方法，通过将瑞利天空模型与来自焦平面分割偏振相机的测量值进行全局优化，来估计车辆航向。所提出的框架结合了针孔相机模型、单次散射瑞利偏振模型以及太阳位置算法，以针对候选车辆状态合成预期的全图像偏振角分布。一种基于偏振度的加权均方根误差目标函数用于比较测量与模拟的偏振模式，使估计器能够利用所有可用的天空信息，同时抑制由云层、建筑物、树叶及其他去偏振遮挡物引起的低置信度像素。实验评估使用了三条城市道路车辆轨迹，这些轨迹由车顶安装的偏振相机和高精度双天线GNSS/INS参考系统采集。结果显示，所有轨迹的横摆角均方根误差均在亚度级别，范围从$0.718^{\circ}$到$0.889^{\circ}$。与具有代表性的基于特征和基于模型的偏振导航方法相比，所提出的方法将航向均方根误差最多降低了87%，并表现出对部分天空遮挡的更强鲁棒性。

Authors: Ben Potter, Eslam Mounier, Aboelmagd Noureldin, Yahia Antar, Muhammad Alam

Memory as Weights: Internalizing Long-Term History for Streaming Videos VLA

streaming video memory as weights LoRA HyperNetwork vision-language-action

简要说明：MaLoW 通过循环超网络将流式视频历史内化为不断更新的 LoRA 权重，避免长上下文竞争，并在视频理解和机器人操作成功率上取得提升。

TLDR: MaLoW internalizes streaming video history into evolving LoRA weights via a recurrent HyperNetwork, avoiding long context competition, and demonstrates gains in video understanding and robot action success.

Abstract: Streaming vision-language models (VLMs) must continuously integrate information from the past while remaining responsive to current observations and user queries. Existing memory mechanisms typically compress, retrieve, or cache historical observations and reintroduce them into the input context, forcing historical memory and current observations to compete for limited context. We propose MaLoW, a streaming memory framework that instead internalizes historical context into evolving lightweight parameter updates. MaLoW uses a recurrent HyperNetwork to incrementally consolidate incoming video observations into fixed-size LoRA weights, allowing historical information to be carried forward without revisiting the full video stream. In doing so, MaLoW represents history as weights, while keeping the current observation as input. To support training, we further construct MaLoW-Instruct, a large-scale streaming video dataset containing 381K question-answer pairs over 56K videos. We conduct extensive experiments to demonstrate that MaLoW achieves strong performance on OVO-Bench, StreamingBench, and StreamArena. On the backward split of OVO-Bench, MaLoW outperforms prior memory approaches by 3.9% to 11.8% across different video backbones while incurring only modest latency overhead. Beyond streaming video understanding, MaLoW also generalizes to vision-language-action models, improving the action success rate on Simpler WidowX by 9.3%.

摘要（中文）：流式视觉语言模型（VLMs）必须持续整合过去的信息，同时保持对当前观测和用户查询的响应能力。现有记忆机制通常对历史观测进行压缩、检索或缓存，并将其重新引入输入上下文，导致历史记忆与当前观测在有限的上下文空间中相互竞争。我们提出MaLoW，一种流式记忆框架，其核心思想是将历史上下文内化到不断演化的轻量级参数更新中。MaLoW利用循环超网络将陆续到达的视频观测逐步整合为固定大小的LoRA权重，从而在不重新访问完整视频流的情况下将历史信息向前传递。通过这种方式，MaLoW将历史表示为权重，而当前观测则保持为输入。为支持训练，我们进一步构建了MaLoW-Instruct，一个包含56K个视频、381K对问答对的大规模流式视频数据集。我们进行了大量实验，证明MaLoW在OVO-Bench、StreamingBench和StreamArena上均取得了优异性能。在OVO-Bench的后向分割中，MaLoW在不同视频骨干网络上比现有记忆方法提升了3.9%至11.8%，且仅引入适度的延迟开销。除流式视频理解外，MaLoW还可推广至视觉-语言-动作模型，将Simpler WidowX上的动作成功率提升了9.3%。

Authors: Zhuoming Liu, Jinhong Lin, Lin Zhang, Yiwu Zhong, Yin Li

CoWorld Reasoner: Agentic Multimodal Reasoning with the Evolving Video World Model-Driven Harness WorldModel

agentic framework video world model visual reasoning VLM co-evolution

简要说明：CoWorld Reasoner 是一个智能体框架，利用视频世界模型作为灵活的视觉推理引擎，使 VLM 能够动态生成并解释视觉证据，以完成时空推理任务。

TLDR: CoWorld Reasoner is an agentic framework that uses a video world model as a flexible visual reasoning engine, enabling VLMs to dynamically generate and interpret visual evidence for spatiotemporal reasoning tasks.

Abstract: As Vision-Language Models (VLMs) advance, they are increasingly expected to perform spatiotemporal reasoning over motion, actions, and view changes beyond what the input images show. Video World Models (VWMs) provide a natural unified engine for visual imagination by generating task-relevant visual content as additional evidence. However, existing approaches typically invoke a VWM through fixed pipelines centered on a predefined form of visual imagination, such as novel-view synthesis. To support flexible visual imagination for diverse reasoning tasks, we introduce CoWorld Reasoner, an agentic framework that uses a VWM as a unified visual reasoning engine. Its Video World Model-Driven Harness exposes multiple visual operations through tools and uses skills to guide the VLM in deciding whether to imagine, selecting an operation, constructing a generation request, and interpreting the resulting visual evidence. We further introduce VLM-VWM Harness Co-Evolution, which jointly revises tools, skills, and execution code based on execution feedback while keeping both model weights fixed. Across seven benchmarks spanning spatial intelligence, temporal and causal reasoning, and perceptual reasoning, CoWorld Reasoner outperforms direct reasoning with the same VLM. The strongest variant improves on all seven benchmarks, including relative accuracy gains of 11.8% on MMSI and 13.0% on ERQA, and outperforms all five evolving baselines using the same backbone across five benchmarks.

摘要（中文）：随着视觉语言模型（VLMs）的不断进步，人们日益期望其能够超越输入图像所呈现的内容，执行涉及运动、动作和视角变化的时空推理。视频世界模型（VWMs）通过生成与任务相关的视觉内容作为补充证据，为视觉想象提供了一种自然的统一引擎。然而，现有方法通常通过围绕预定义视觉想象形式（如新视角合成）的固定流程来调用VWM。为了支持多样化推理任务的灵活视觉想象，我们引入了CoWorld Reasoner，这是一个智能体框架，将VWM用作统一的视觉推理引擎。其视频世界模型驱动驾驭机制（Video World Model-Driven Harness）通过工具暴露多种视觉操作，并利用技能引导VLM决定是否进行想象、选择操作、构建生成请求以及解读生成的视觉证据。我们进一步提出了VLM-VWM驾驭协同进化（VLM-VWM Harness Co-Evolution），该方法基于执行反馈联合修订工具、技能和执行代码，同时保持两个模型的权重不变。在涵盖空间智能、时间与因果推理以及感知推理的七个基准测试中，CoWorld Reasoner均优于使用相同VLM的直接推理方法。最强变体在所有七个基准上均取得提升，其中在MMSI和ERQA上的相对准确率分别提高了11.8%和13.0%，并且在五个基准上优于使用相同主干网络的所有五个进化基线方法。

Authors: Dongjie Cheng, Ruifeng Yuan, Ran Wei, Ning Song, Yongqi Li, Wenjie Li

Velox: Spatial Memory Makes World Models Efficient WorldModel

video world models attention routing frustum slabs memory efficiency diffusion

简要说明：Velox 是一种免训练的注意力路由器，利用几何截锥体表示高效保留视频世界模型中的视觉记忆，从而加速长时程生成并保持质量。

TLDR: Velox is a training-free attention router for video world models that uses geometric frustum-slabs to retain visual memory efficiently, accelerating long-horizon rollouts while maintaining generation quality.

Abstract: Video world models turn actions and camera motion into long visual rollouts, making video a natural interface for interactive simulation. Such interaction requires responsive generation, yet coherent rollouts must retain visual memory of what has already been generated. Chunked video diffusion models usually keep this context in growing KV caches, so later chunks become progressively slower. To address this bottleneck, we introduce Velox, a training-free attention router for region-level context selection using frustum slab correspondences from streaming geometry. Velox represents historical blocks as camera frustum slabs with depth intervals and obtains current-block depth through recency-priority multiwarp. For well-covered regions, frustum slab overlap softly modulates each layer's model-derived block importance. Uncovered regions retain the model-derived route without geometric bias. The fixed token-block granularity matches FlashAttention-style tiled execution and reduces the attention term that grows with rollout length. Frustum slab construction runs asynchronously with denoising on the same H200. At chunk 48, Velox accelerates attention by $4.36\times$ and denoising by $2.43\times$. On the full 158-case WBench navigation split, it remains within 0.15 API-free average points of dense LingBot-Fast-Cam. Please see our project page at https://velox-world.com/velox/ for more details.

摘要（中文）：视频世界模型将动作和相机运动转化为长程视觉推演，使视频成为交互式仿真的自然接口。这种交互要求实时响应，而连贯的推演必须保留已生成内容的视觉记忆。分块视频扩散模型通常将该上下文保存在不断增长的KV缓存中，因此后续分块会逐渐变慢。为解决这一瓶颈，我们提出Velox，一种免训练的注意力路由器，利用流式几何中的视锥体切片对应关系进行区域级上下文选择。Velox将历史块表示为带深度区间的相机视锥体切片，并通过最近优先的多重扭曲获取当前块深度。对于覆盖良好的区域，视锥体切片重叠会以软方式调节每层模型导出的块重要性。未覆盖区域则保留模型导出的路由，不引入几何偏差。固定的token-块粒度与FlashAttention风格的平铺执行相匹配，并缩减了随推演长度增长的注意力项。视锥体切片的构建与去噪在同一H200上异步运行。在第48分块时，Velox将注意力加速4.36倍，去噪加速2.43倍。在完整158例WBench导航划分上，其API-free平均分与密集版LingBot-Fast-Cam的差距保持在0.15分以内。更多详情请参阅我们的项目页面：https://velox-world.com/velox/。

Authors: Qiuhong Shen, Shizun Wang, Xinchao Wang

FALCON: FPGA-Accelerated Latency-Certifiable Occupancy Networks for Camera-Based Autonomous Driving Perception3D

FPGA 3D occupancy latency guarantee camera-based perception autonomous driving

简要说明：FALCON 提出一种基于 FPGA 的摄像头 3D 占用感知前端，用于自动驾驶，重点是保证最坏情况下的延迟而非平均延迟。它通过循环有界 PL 计算、推理包络和看门狗确保输出在截止时间内交付，在 Occ3D-nuScenes 上达到 29.88 mIoU，功耗更低且尾部延迟远优于 GPU 方案。

TLDR: FALCON presents an FPGA-based camera-only 3D occupancy perception front-end for autonomous driving, focusing on enforcing worst-case latency guarantees rather than average latency. It uses cycle-bounded PL compute, measured inference envelopes, and a watchdog to ensure outputs are delivered within deadlines, achieving mIoU 29.88 on Occ3D-nuScenes at lower power and much tighter tail latency than GPU alternatives.

Abstract: A perception system that must brake for a pedestrian does not need a low average latency. It must deliver an answer before the deadline on every frame, the worst case included. Commodity edge accelerators optimize the mean through dynamic scheduling, OS jitter, thermal throttling, and contention, so their per-frame latency can be measured but not bounded. We build FALCON, a camera-based 3D occupancy front-end on the AMD Kria KR260, an embedded FPGA drawing 4.3 W idle and up to 6.6 W under inference, and make the latency guarantee layered and explicit: programmable-logic (PL) compute is cycle-bounded analytically; inference is a measured envelope over 100k-frame traces; and a watchdog enforces output delivery, publishing the previous output flagged stale when a frame is late. The deadline runs use a fixed-work proxy of six ResNet-50 DPU inferences per frame, not the full occupancy network: across three 100k-frame enforced runs, all 300k proxy frames delivered an output within the 100 ms deadline plus at most 10.2 ms, the worst of the three runs. The full six-camera FlashOcc pipeline composes to about 1.3 s per frame on the board and is not yet a 10 Hz system. The two operations the DPU cannot run, a view-transform gather and a bilinear resize, become fixed-trip-count PL IPs numerically matched to their software references. On the full Occ3D-nuScenes validation set the board reaches mIoU 29.88, 92.8% of an FP32 baseline the DPU cannot run. On a ResNet-50 probe over 100k frames the KR260 tail stays within 1.5 times its median (2.0 times for the six-inference proxy), where Jetson Orin reaches 4.4 times and the worst datacenter GPU run (NVIDIA L4) 23.6 times. The deployment recipe, HLS sources, and raw timing traces are released.

摘要（中文）：一个必须为行人刹车的感知系统，并不需要较低的平均延迟。它必须在每一帧的截止时间前给出答案，包括最坏情况在内。商用边缘加速器通过动态调度、操作系统抖动、热降频和资源争用优化均值，因此其逐帧延迟可被测量但无法被界定。我们构建了FALCON，一个基于摄像头的3D占用前端系统，运行在AMD Kria KR260上——这是一款嵌入式FPGA，空闲功耗4.3瓦，推理时最高6.6瓦，并将延迟保证分层化且显式化：可编程逻辑（PL）计算在分析上具有周期可界定性；推理是在10万帧轨迹上测得的包络；而看门狗强制执行输出交付，当某一帧迟到时，发布前一个输出并标记为过期。截止时间测试使用每帧六次ResNet-50 DPU推理的固定工作量代理，而非完整的占用网络：在三次各10万帧的强制执行测试中，全部30万代理帧均在100毫秒截止时间内交付输出，且最长为100毫秒加最多10.2毫秒（为三次测试中的最差值）。完整的六摄像头FlashOcc流水线在板上组合约为每帧1.3秒，尚不能达到10Hz系统。DPU无法运行的两个操作——视图变换聚合和双线性缩放——被实现为固定循环次数的PL知识产权核（IP），并在数值上与软件参考结果匹配。在完整Occ3D-nuScenes验证集上，该板卡达到mIoU 29.88，为DPU无法运行的FP32基线的92.8%。在10万帧的ResNet-50探针测试中，KR260的尾延迟保持在其中位数的1.5倍以内（六推理代理为2.0倍），而Jetson Orin达到4.4倍，最差的数GPU（NVIDIA L4）运行达到23.6倍。部署方法、HLS源码和原始时序轨迹均已发布。

Authors: Haohua Que, Mingkai Liu, Handong Yao

Asking Smarter Questions: Targeted Active Preference Learning for Underspecified Rewards RLRobot

active preference learning reward learning informed prior explanations underspecified rewards

简要说明：本文提出了一种用于机器人奖励学习的主动偏好学习方法，利用信息先验针对监督不足的任务特征进行查询，并通过解释引导人类注意力，从而提高奖励恢复效果并减少人类努力。

TLDR: This paper proposes an active preference learning method for reward learning in robotics that uses an informed prior to target queries at poorly supervised task features and accompanies queries with explanations to focus human attention, improving reward recovery and reducing human effort.

Abstract: Reward learning typically assumes the human's input covers everything that matters for the task. In practice, humans can only attend to so much at once, so their teaching naturally captures some features---or aspects of the task---better than others. Prior work has shown how the robot can identify which features were poorly supervised directly from its teaching data. But the current solution is to ask the human to try again, putting the burden on someone who already struggled to convey those features. We propose shifting this burden to the robot. Our key insight is that the same information that tells the robot what it doesn't know can help it ask better questions. Preference queries offer a low-effort channel for resolving this uncertainty, but only if the robot knows where to direct them and the human knows what to attend to when answering. We act on this insight in two ways: we build an informed prior that targets preference queries at the features that need resolving, and we accompany each query with an explanation that focuses the human's attention on exactly those features. In simulation, the informed prior beats the standard active preference learning baseline by up to $30.8\%$ in the low-query regime, where reducing human effort matters most. In a user study, the informed prior and explanations each significantly improve reward recovery and amplify each other.

摘要（中文）：奖励学习通常假设人类的输入涵盖了任务中所有重要的因素。然而在实践中，人类一次只能关注有限的信息，因此他们的教导自然会对某些特征——或任务的不同方面——关注得更好，而对其他特征则关注不足。先前的研究已经展示了机器人如何直接从其教学数据中识别出哪些特征未被充分监督。但现有的解决方案是要求人类重新尝试，将负担转嫁给那些本就在传达这些特征方面遇到困难的人。我们建议将这一负担转移给机器人。我们的关键洞见是：告诉机器人它所不知道的信息，同样可以帮助它提出更好的问题。偏好查询为消除这种不确定性提供了一种低成本的渠道，但这只有当机器人知道将问题指向何处，并且人类在回答时知道应关注什么时才有效。我们通过两种方式践行这一洞见：我们构建了一个信息丰富的先验，将偏好查询精准定位到需要解决的特征上；同时，我们为每次查询附带一个解释，将人类的注意力集中到这些特定特征上。在仿真实验中，信息丰富的先验在低查询次数场景下比标准主动偏好学习基线最多提升$30.8\%$的性能，而这一场景正是减少人类负担最为关键的地方。在用户研究中，信息丰富的先验和解释各自显著提升了奖励恢复的效果，并且二者相互增强。

Authors: Helena Merker, Nick Walker, Andreea Bobu

CF-Splat: Closed-Form Triangle Splatting with Mesh Priors Perception3D

triangle splatting closed-form linear least-squares novel-view synthesis mesh priors

简要说明：CF-Splat 提出了一种基于已知网格的闭合形式三角溅射框架，将多视角外观估计转化为全局线性最小二乘问题，在显著降低计算时间和 GPU 内存的前提下，实现了与 3DGS 相当或更优的新视角合成质量。

TLDR: CF-Splat proposes a closed-form triangle-splatting framework that formulates multi-view appearance estimation over a known mesh as a global linear least-squares problem, achieving competitive novel-view synthesis quality with significantly reduced computation time and GPU memory compared to 3DGS.

Abstract: Splatting-based radiance-field representations have recently gained popularity in robotic perception, enabling high-quality novel-view synthesis (NVS) through explicit scene primitives. However, existing splatting methods typically rely on iterative nonlinear optimization that jointly optimizes millions of coupled primitive parameters, resulting in substantial computation time, peak GPU memory consumption, and susceptibility to local minima. In this paper, we propose CF-Splat, a novel closed-form triangle-splatting framework for efficient scene appearance estimation over a known mesh either pre-existing or provided by upstream mapping or reconstruction pipelines. Our key insight is that, by properly formulating the problem over the given mesh geometry and calibrated cameras, the rendered pixel colors can be expressed linearly with respect to the per-vertex spherical harmonics (SH) coefficients, allowing multi-view scene appearance estimation to be formulated as a global linear least-squares (LLS) problem without the need of iterative nonlinear optimization. To guarantee a well-posed solution under uneven multi-view observation coverage, we introduce adaptive SH regularization that constrains insufficiently supported high-order SH coefficients and yields a unique global minimizer. To ensure the scalability to large-scale scenes, we develop a triangle-structured matrix-free preconditioned conjugate-gradient solver that avoids explicitly constructing the large sparse normal system while producing the same LLS solution. Experiments on diverse real-world datasets demonstrate that CF-Splat achieves competitive or superior NVS quality compared with state-of-the-art splatting methods. While, CF-Splat requires approximately 27.5-378.0 times less computation time and 1.8 times lower peak GPU memory on average than 3DGS across scenes of different scales on a consumer-grade laptop.

摘要（中文）：基于溅射的辐射场表示近年来在机器人感知领域受到广泛关注，通过显式场景基元实现了高质量的新视角合成（NVS）。然而，现有的溅射方法通常依赖迭代非线性优化，联合优化数百万个耦合的基元参数，导致计算时间显著、GPU峰值内存消耗高，且容易陷入局部最优解。本文提出CF-Splat，一种新颖的闭式三角形溅射框架，用于在已知网格（既可以是预先存在的，也可以由上游建图或重建流程提供）上进行高效场景外观估计。我们的关键洞察在于：通过在给定网格几何和标定相机下合理构建问题，渲染像素颜色可以表示为每个顶点球谐（SH）系数的线性函数，从而将多视角场景外观估计建模为全局线性最小二乘（LLS）问题，无需迭代非线性优化。为保证在多视角观测覆盖不均匀时解是适定的，我们引入自适应SH正则化，约束支撑不足的高阶SH系数，并得到唯一的全局最小化解。为了确保对大规模场景的可扩展性，我们开发了一种基于三角形结构的无矩阵预条件共轭梯度求解器，避免了显式构建大型稀疏法方程组，同时获得相同的LLS解。在多个真实世界数据集上的实验表明，CF-Splat相比最先进的溅射方法在NVS质量上具有竞争力或更优表现。同时，在消费级笔记本电脑上，针对不同规模的场景，CF-Splat的计算时间比3DGS平均减少约27.5至378.0倍，峰值GPU内存平均降低约1.8倍。

Authors: Yixin Fang, Liang Zhao

De-Risking Robotic Welding for In-Space Metal Joining Through Physics-Grounded Digital Twins Manipulation

digital twin robotic welding Gaussian process finite-volume model simulated manipulator

简要说明：本文提出了一种基于物理的机器人焊接数字孪生框架，用于降低太空金属连接风险，结合热熔池模型、高斯过程/神经网络替代模型和六轴机械臂仿真，并通过仿真结果支持其在实验前筛选焊接条件与控制策略。

TLDR: This paper presents a physics-grounded digital twin for de-risking robotic welding in space, combining thermal weld-pool models, Gaussian-process/neural-network surrogates, and a simulated six-axis manipulator, with simulation results supporting its use for screening welding conditions and control strategies.

Abstract: Growing interest in in-space servicing, manufacturing, and assembly has renewed attention on reliable metal joining for modular construction and on-orbit repair. Robotic welding is promising, but reduced-gravity and low-pressure operation remains poorly characterised and flight-like tests are limited. The UK Space Agency-supported ISPARK project is developing a physics-grounded digital twin for structured process de-risking. This paper evaluates a model-based prototype combining a finite-volume thermal weld-pool model, Gaussian-process (GP) and neural-network surrogates, and a simulated six-axis manipulator. The reduced model includes solid-liquid phase change, effective thermocapillary transport, and a local-pressure parameter. Gravity is assessed separately through a hydrostatic-to-capillary pressure ratio and does not enter the thermal energy equation. Across repeated five-fold cross-validation, the GP has lower normalised mean absolute error than the neural network for all eight outputs. In 10 held-out boundary cases, 74 of 80 solver responses fall within nominal 90% GP predictive intervals. A three-output GP query takes 249 microseconds, including scaling and predictive variance. In a simulated UR5 L-shaped-seam study, a proportional controller adjusts the synergic power-source setting as travel speed falls near the corner. Finite-volume re-evaluation finds all 12 closed-loop operating points and 9 of 12 open-loop points within an illustrative 1.0-3.0 mm root-side-width band. These simulation results support using the framework to screen welding conditions and control strategies before experimental tests. Thermal-vacuum, targeted reduced-gravity, and robotic hardware-in-the-loop studies are needed to assess the model and controller.

摘要（中文）：摘要： 随着对太空在轨服务、制造与组装兴趣的日益增长，模块化建造与在轨修复中对可靠金属连接技术的关注再度升温。机器人焊接前景广阔，但低重力与低压环境下的操作特性仍缺乏充分表征，且飞行级测试十分有限。由英国航天局资助的ISPARK项目正在开发一种基于物理原理的数字孪生系统，用于结构化工艺风险消减。本文评估了一套基于模型的原型系统，该系统结合了有限体积热焊池模型、高斯过程（GP）与神经网络代理模型，以及一台模拟六轴机械臂。简化模型涵盖固液相变、有效热毛细输运及局部压力参数。重力通过静水压与毛细压之比单独评估，不进入热能方程。在重复五折交叉验证中，GP在所有八项输出上的归一化平均绝对误差均低于神经网络。在10组留出边界案例中，80个求解器响应中的74个落在标称90% GP预测区间内。三次输出GP查询耗时249微秒，包含缩放与预测方差计算。在模拟UR5 L形焊缝研究中，比例控制器在行进速度接近拐角时调节协同电源设置。有限体积重新评估发现，12个闭环工作点全部及12个开环点中的9个位于示例性1.0–3.0 mm根部宽度带内。这些仿真结果支持在实验测试前使用该框架筛选焊接条件与控制策略。后续还需开展热真空、针对性低重力及机器人硬件在环研究，以评估模型与控制器性能。

Authors: Zhou Daniel Hao, Umer Masood Chaudry, Robert Shaw, Andrew Cheney, Nick Ludford, Mark Sims, Hongbiao Dong

A Flow-Theoretic Multimodal Control Framework Fusing Mental and Physical Engagement for Upper-Limb Rehabilitation Other

rehabilitation robotics brain-machine interface assist-as-needed control adaptive impedance control multimodal physiological sensing

简要说明：本文提出一种用于上肢康复的多模态控制框架，融合基于EEG的心理参与和基于sEMG的身体参与，实现自适应阻抗控制，在健康被试中减少了机器人能量消耗并提高了心流状态比例。

TLDR: This paper introduces a multimodal control framework for upper-limb rehabilitation that fuses EEG-based mental engagement and sEMG-based physical engagement into an adaptive impedance control strategy, demonstrating reduced robotic energy expenditure and increased flow state ratio in healthy participants.

Abstract: While Assist-as-Needed (AAN) control aims to maximize user participation in robot-assisted training, existing methods relying solely on physical metrics cannot distinguish muscular inability from mental disengagement, leading to suboptimal interventions. To address this ambiguity, a Flow-theoretic multimodal AAN framework is proposed, fusing EEG-based mental engagement and sEMG-based physical engagement into an adaptive impedance control strategy. A four-quadrant fuzzy decision engine translates these dual physiological metrics into continuous control policies. This enables the upper-limb exoskeleton to inject feedforward assistance during intent-execution mismatch (e.g., motor output attenuation despite mental focus) and escalate guiding stiffness to penalize mental distraction. The framework was validated with healthy participants against a state-of-practice sEMG-only AAN baseline. Kinematically and mechanically, the proposed framework reduced robotic energy expenditure by 71.9\% while maintaining precise trajectory tracking, confirming it elicited greater voluntary human effort. Physiologically, the system increased the time spent in the neuroplasticity zone (Flow State Ratio) from 4.6% to 42.8%. These results validate that decoupling and jointly regulating mental and physical states enhances the selectivity of robotic assistance, mitigating user passivity and sustaining the engagement crucial for motor learning.

摘要（中文）：虽然按需辅助（AAN）控制旨在最大化用户在机器人辅助训练中的参与度，但现有仅依赖物理指标的方法无法区分肌肉能力不足与心理参与度低下，从而导致干预效果欠佳。为解决这一模糊性问题，本文提出了一种基于心流理论的 multimodal AAN 框架，将基于脑电（EEG）的心理参与度和基于表面肌电（sEMG）的物理参与度融合到自适应阻抗控制策略中。一个四象限模糊决策引擎将这些双重生理指标转化为连续的控制策略。这使得上肢外骨骼能够在意图-执行不匹配时（例如，尽管心理专注但运动输出衰减）注入前馈辅助，并通过增强引导刚度来惩罚心理分心。该框架在健康受试者中与现有仅基于 sEMG 的 AAN 基线进行了验证。在运动学和力学方面，所提出的框架将机器人能量消耗降低了 71.9%，同时保持了精确的轨迹跟踪，证实其引发了更大的自主人体努力。在生理学方面，该系统将处于神经可塑性区的时间占比（心流状态比）从 4.6% 提升至 42.8%。这些结果验证了将心理和物理状态解耦并联合调节能够增强机器人辅助的选择性，减轻用户被动性，并维持对运动学习至关重要的参与度。

Authors: Jun Leng, Pengcheng Li, Hanze Wang, Shuxiang Guo, Junlin Jiang

A 2D Image Feedback-Based Autonomous Endovascular Navigation Method: A Perception and Control Framework Other

endovascular navigation 2D image feedback perception control robotic platform

简要说明：本文提出了一种基于2D图像反馈的自主血管内导航感知与控制框架，并在物理机器人平台上进行了验证。

TLDR: This paper presents a perception and control framework for autonomous endovascular navigation using 2D image feedback, validated on a physical robotic platform with simulator-rendered images.

Abstract: In endovascular interventions, physicians rely on planar DSA and X-ray fluoroscopy to interpret vessel anatomy and device motion, yet converting these images into feedback for autonomous navigation remains difficult. A perception and control method is formulated for two-dimensional image feedback. Vessel masks are converted into a labeled centerline graph, and device-tip estimates are projected onto a planned path to obtain progress, deviation, and direction. A rule-based controller uses these quantities for delivery, branch selection, probing, rollback, and recovery. The method was evaluated on a physical dual-device robotic platform in 65 closed-loop runs using simulator-rendered planar images across three paths. All runs reached at least 0.95 maximum observed guidewire progress; two runs (3.1%) met the prespecified failure rule of three or more autonomous stop events. The results establish route-level performance on the tested platform; clinical image sequences and broader anatomy remain to be evaluated.

摘要（中文）：在血管内介入治疗中，医生依赖于平面DSA和X射线透视图像来理解血管解剖结构和器械运动，但将这些图像转化为自主导航的反馈信息仍然具有挑战性。本文提出了一种基于二维图像反馈的感知与控制方法。血管掩膜被转换为带标签的中心线图，器械尖端估计值被投影到规划路径上，以获取进度、偏差和方向信息。一个基于规则的控制器利用这些信息进行输送、分支选择、试探、回退和恢复操作。该方法在物理双器械机器人平台上进行了评估，使用模拟器生成的平面图像，共完成65次闭环运行，覆盖三条路径。所有运行的导丝最大观测进度均达到至少0.95；两次运行（3.1%）达到预设的失败规则，即发生三次或以上自主停止事件。实验结果确立了该方法在测试平台上的路径级性能；临床图像序列及更广泛的解剖结构仍需进一步评估。

Hierarchical Building-Floo-Room Framework for Privacy-Preserving Autonomous Delivery in Large-Scale Buildings Other

hierarchical planning CVRP privacy-preserving delivery multi-sensor robot navigation

简要说明：本文提出了一种基于建筑-楼层-房间分层框架的隐私保护自主配送系统，结合多层CVRP优化与实际多传感器机器人平台，实现了可靠的跨楼层配送。

TLDR: This paper presents a hierarchical Building-Floor-Room framework for privacy-preserving autonomous delivery in large-scale buildings, integrating multi-level CVRP optimization with a real multi-sensor robotic platform for reliable multi-floor navigation.

Abstract: Autonomous delivery in large scale buildings requires coordinated planning across multiple spatial levels, including building, floor, and room, while ensuring scheduling efficiency. Existing methods often focus solely on algorithmic development, neglecting integration with physical robotic platforms, and rarely validate performance in real world scenarios. Many approaches also overlook hierarchical building structures and room level privacy constraints, limiting practical applicability. To address these challenges, this paper presents a hierarchical delivery framework based on a Building-Floor-Room abstraction, which decomposes the problem across multiple levels to significantly reduce optimization complexity. We formulate a building aware extension of the capacitated vehicle routing problem (CVRP) that explicitly models inter building and inter floor connectivity, room level access constraints, and privacy sensitive areas, enabling globally feasible and privacy compliant task assignment and routing. Based on this hierarchical model, the framework can evaluate delivery efficiency across different building layouts and optimize depot placement for specific configurations. At the execution level, we introduce a novel hardware design for non interactive, privacy preserving delivery, supported by reachability aware distances and a closed loop mapping, localization, and navigation system, ensuring consistency between planned routes and physical navigation. The proposed framework is validated on a real multi sensor robotic platform, demonstrating reliable multi floor delivery with improved path rationality and overall efficiency.

摘要（中文）：大型建筑内的自主配送需要在建筑、楼层和房间等多个空间层面上进行协同规划，同时确保调度效率。现有方法往往仅聚焦于算法开发，忽视与物理机器人平台的集成，且很少在真实场景中验证性能。许多方法还忽略了建筑的分层结构以及房间级隐私约束，限制了其实际应用性。为应对这些挑战，本文提出了一种基于建筑-楼层-房间抽象的分层配送框架，将问题在多个层次上进行分解，从而显著降低优化复杂度。我们构建了容量约束车辆路径问题（CVRP）的一种建筑感知扩展形式，显式建模建筑间与楼层间的连通性、房间级访问约束及隐私敏感区域，从而实现全局可行且符合隐私要求的任务分配与路径规划。基于该分层模型，框架能够评估不同建筑布局下的配送效率，并针对特定配置优化仓库选址。在执行层面，我们提出了一种新颖的硬件设计，用于非交互、隐私保护的配送，辅以基于可达性感知距离的定位与映射方法，以及闭环的建图、定位与导航系统，确保规划路径与物理导航之间的一致性。该框架在真实的多传感器机器人平台上得到了验证，展示了可靠的多楼层配送能力，并提升了路径合理性与整体效率。

Authors: Xu Xiaoji, Luo Rui, Chen Jinhua, Xiang Changying, Zhang Leihan, Liao Zhongyuan

Vision-Guided Closed-Loop Autonomous Navigation of Light-Driven Janus Microbots Other

vision-guided navigation Janus microbots closed-loop control YOLOv11 object detection A* path planning

简要说明：本文提出了一种光驱动Janus微机器人的视觉引导闭环导航框架，集成基于YOLOv11的实时定位、航点磁力转向和A*路径规划，实现动态微环境中的精确自主导航、避障和货物运输。

TLDR: This paper presents a vision-guided closed-loop navigation framework for light-driven Janus microbots, integrating real-time YOLOv11-based localization, waypoint magnetic steering, and A* path planning for precise autonomous navigation, obstacle avoidance, and cargo delivery in dynamic microscale environments.

Abstract: Artificial microbots capable of precise and autonomous navigation could provide versatile platforms for microscale transport, manipulation, and task execution in complex environments. However, reliable navigation becomes increasingly challenging at the micrometre scale, particularly when the surrounding environment changes dynamically. Here, we develop a vision-guided closed-loop navigation framework for light-driven cube-shaped hematite/TiO2 Janus microbots with a characteristic size of approximately 3 μm. Real-time visual localization using a custom-trained YOLOv11 object-detection model is integrated with discretized waypoint-based magnetic steering to enable precise navigation along complex prescribed trajectories, with more than 90% of the measured trajectory deviations remaining below 6 μm across the tested path geometries. The framework further enables arbitrary user-defined free-hand trajectories and autonomous navigation through a physically confined maze. In dynamically changing environments, A* path planning enables real-time path replanning while avoiding multiple independently swimming 5 μm spherical Janus micromotors. Finally, the microbot selectively captures multiple cargo particles and autonomously transports and delivers them to a predefined location while simultaneously avoiding dynamic obstacles. These results establish an integrated platform combining programmable trajectory control, autonomous path planning, real-time environmental adaptation, and task execution within a single light-driven Janus microbot system.

摘要（中文）：摘要：能够在复杂环境中实现精确自主导航的人工微型机器人，可为其在微尺度运输、操控及任务执行方面提供通用平台。然而，在微米尺度下，可靠导航的难度显著增加，尤其是在周围环境动态变化的情况下。本研究开发了一种基于视觉引导的闭环导航框架，用于尺寸约3 μm的光驱动立方体赤铁矿/TiO₂ Janus微型机器人。通过自定义训练的YOLOv11目标检测模型实现实时视觉定位，并结合基于离散航路点的磁场转向控制，使该机器人能够沿复杂预设轨迹精确导航，在所测试的路径几何形状中，超过90%的实测轨迹偏差保持在6 μm以内。该框架还可实现任意用户自定义的自由手绘轨迹，以及在物理受限迷宫中的自主导航。在动态变化环境中，A*路径规划能实时重新规划路径，同时规避多个独立游动的5 μm球形Janus微型马达。最后，该微型机器人可选择性地捕获多个货物微粒，并在规避动态障碍物的同时，将其自主运输并递送至预定位置。上述成果构建了一个集成可编程轨迹控制、自主路径规划、实时环境适应及任务执行于一体的光驱动Janus微型机器人系统平台。

Slip-Induced Fall Suppression During Cornering for a Remotely Operated Motorcycle with a Rear-Wheel-Swing Mechanism Locomotion

slip-induced fall suppression remotely operated motorcycle rear-wheel-swing mechanism assistive control low-friction surfaces

简要说明：本文提出一种利用后轮摆动机制抑制远程操控摩托车打滑摔倒的控制方法，并通过低摩擦路面和仿真冰面实验验证。

TLDR: This paper presents a control method to suppress slip-induced falls in remotely operated motorcycles using a rear-wheel-swing mechanism, validated through experiments on low-friction surfaces and synthetic ice.

Abstract: Slip-induced falls when riding motorcycles are difficult to avoid even for expert riders and represent a major cause of single-vehicle accidents. Despite their prevalence, no practical solution has yet been proposed to suppress this phenomenon. We previously introduced a motorcycle model applicable to systems with both front- and rear- wheel steering. In this paper, we extend that model and formulate the suppression of slip-induced falls as an optimization problem that distributes assistive control inputs according to vehicle speed and road surface conditions. To evaluate the proposed method, we developed a remotely operated motorcycle and conducted experiments under two scenarios: slalom driving on a low-friction surface at 5.5 m/s, and turning maneuvers on synthetic ice to simulate driving over manholes on rainy days. The results demonstrate that our approach successfully suppresses falls under these challenging conditions.

摘要（中文）：摩托车骑行中因打滑引发的摔车事故即使对经验丰富的骑手而言也难以避免，且是单车事故的主要原因之一。尽管此类事故频发，目前尚无实用解决方案来抑制这一现象。我们此前提出了一种适用于前后轮均具备转向能力系统的摩托车模型。本文在既有模型基础上进行扩展，将打滑引发摔车的抑制问题表述为一个优化问题，该问题根据车速及路面条件分配辅助控制输入。为评估所提方法，我们开发了一台遥控操作摩托车，并在两种场景下开展实验：一是在低摩擦路面上以5.5米/秒的速度进行蛇形绕桩驾驶，二是在人造冰面上进行转弯操作，以模拟雨天行驶于窨井盖上方的情形。实验结果表明，所提方法在上述苛刻条件下能够成功抑制摔车现象。

Authors: Tadashi Sumioka, Kazushi Akimoto, Takuya Tsujimura, Sho Takayanagi, Kineo Tomura

Optimally Trading Energy for Information through Speed Trajectory Optimization of Sustainably Powered Mobile Robots Other

speed trajectory optimization optimal control mobile robots information gain sustainable energy

简要说明：本文提出了一种可持续供电移动机器人速度轨迹优化的周期最优控制方法，在能量消耗与信息获取之间取得平衡，并给出了理论最优条件和盐度监测仿真研究。

TLDR: This paper presents a periodic optimal control formulation for speed trajectory optimization of sustainably powered mobile robots, balancing energy expenditure against information gain, with theoretical optimality conditions and a salinity-monitoring simulation study.

Abstract: Sustainably powered mobile robots enable long-duration observational missions by harvesting energy from the environment. However, effective autonomy requires the robots to make decisions as to how to allocate this energy to maximize information quality over time. In this paper, we study a persistent (infinite-horizon) speed trajectory optimization problem that is posed as a periodic optimal control problem in which a robot repeatedly traverses a fixed closed path, coupling a super-linear propulsion cost with dynamic information gain and decay. Using the information-theoretic quantity of clarity as an information metric, we first derive the necessary conditions for optimal control. We then derive a number of specialized follow-on properties, which characterize (i) the nature of the optimal control when points on the path are of varying importance and when they are of equal importance, along with (ii) a high-speed information limit that is approached when energy reserves approach infinity. We illustrate the information-optimal speed trajectories on a simple example in order to showcase key trends that are followed under the optimized speed profile. This is followed by a simulation study based on the persistent characterization of salinity in the Chesapeake Bay, illustrating the practical merit of applying the results from this work.

摘要（中文）：可持续供电的移动机器人通过从环境中采集能量，能够执行长时间的观测任务。然而，有效的自主性要求机器人能够决策如何分配这些能量，以随着时间推移最大化信息质量。在本文中，我们研究了一个持久性（无限时域）速度轨迹优化问题，该问题被构建为一个周期性最优控制问题，其中机器人反复沿一条固定闭合路径行进，将超线性推进成本与动态信息增益和衰减耦合在一起。以信息论中的清晰度作为信息度量，我们首先推导了最优控制的必要条件。随后，我们推导了一系列专门的推论性质，这些性质表征了（i）当路径上各点重要性不同以及重要性相同时最优控制的特性，以及（ii）当能量储备趋近于无穷大时所接近的高速信息极限。我们通过一个简单示例展示了信息最优速度轨迹，以突出优化速度曲线下的关键趋势。随后，基于切萨皮克湾盐度持续特性的仿真研究，验证了本文成果在实际应用中的价值。

Constrained Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning in Imagination WorldModel

Multi-Agent RL World Model Constrained RL Imagination Cost Prediction

简要说明：CA-MAMBA 将多智能体强化学习与世界模型相结合，在想象中执行受约束的策略更新，在 SMAC 和 MAMuJoCo 基准测试中以更少的交互次数获得更高奖励和更低成本，优于无模型基线。

TLDR: CA-MAMBA combines multi-agent reinforcement learning with world models to enable constrained policy updates in imagination, achieving higher rewards and lower cost with fewer interactions than model-free baselines on SMAC and MAMuJoCo benchmarks.

Abstract: Predicting cost in a multi-agent world model moves most constrained policy updates into imagination: the stronger model-free baseline needs $10$ to $20$ times CA-MAMBA's interactions on the median SMAC configuration, and CA-MAMBA earns $2.8$ to $12$ times the baselines' MAMuJoCo reward at equal budget. In controlled tests on one task per benchmark, pricing the model's cost advantages at parity more than halves a cost-blind learner's cost and meets a tight continuous-control limit the learned multiplier misses, suggesting the model's cost estimates are not the bottleneck.

摘要（中文）：在多智能体世界模型中预测成本，能将大多数受限策略更新转移至想象空间：在SMAC配置的中位数水平下，更强的无模型基线所需交互次数是CA-MAMBA的10至20倍，而在相同预算下，CA-MAMBA在MAMuJoCo基准上的奖励是基线的2.8至12倍。在每项基准各一任务的受控测试中，若将模型的成本优势按平价定价，能使不关注成本的学习者成本降低逾半，并达到学习所得的乘子所无法企及的严格连续控制极限，这表明模型的成本估计并非瓶颈所在。

Authors: Raz Shmueli, Shahaf S. Shperberg

SpaceCache: Intermediate Feature Reuse for Efficient Semantic Segmentation on Point Cloud Streams Perception3D

feature reuse point cloud streams semantic segmentation transformer autonomous driving

简要说明：SpaceCache 提出一种无训练的特征缓存，用于点云 Transformer，通过跨帧复用中间特征，将流式语义分割速度提升至 1.65 倍，且精度损失很小。

TLDR: SpaceCache introduces a training-free feature cache for point-cloud transformers, reusing intermediate features across frames to speed up semantic segmentation on streams by up to 1.65x with minimal accuracy loss.

Abstract: Point-cloud streams are central to autonomous driving and robotics, yet existing segmentation networks process every frame from scratch, although consecutive frames largely overlap. We observe that the intermediate features of point-cloud transformers remain semantically consistent across frames for the same spatial region, especially in deep stages. Building on this, we present SpaceCache, a training-free feature cache that reuses these features across frames. Tokens of previously observed regions skip a sequence of transformer blocks and take their cached features, only the remaining tokens are computed, and the full token layout is restored for dense prediction. Lightweight cache management keeps reused features reliable by limiting each entry's age and evicting low-confidence entries. Unlike token merging, SpaceCache selects tokens at negligible cost and runs its cache operations once per encoder stage. On both outdoor and indoor benchmarks, such as nuScenes, Waymo, and ScanNet, with two transformer backbones of Utonia and LitePT-B, SpaceCache achieves up to 1.65x speedup with less than 1-point mIoU drop and consistently outperforms token-merging methods.

摘要（中文）：点云流是自动驾驶和机器人技术的核心，然而现有的分割网络对每一帧都从头处理，尽管连续帧之间存在大量重叠。我们观察到，点云 Transformer 的中间特征在相同空间区域的不同帧之间保持语义一致性，尤其是在深层阶段。基于此，我们提出了 SpaceCache，一种无需训练的 Feature Cache，用于跨帧复用这些特征。先前观测区域的 Token 跳过一系列 Transformer 块，直接使用其缓存特征，仅对剩余 Token 进行计算，同时恢复完整的 Token 布局以进行密集预测。轻量级缓存管理通过限制每个条目的有效期并驱逐低置信度条目来保持复用特征的可靠性。与 Token 合并方法不同，SpaceCache 以极低成本选择 Token，并在每个编码器阶段仅执行一次缓存操作。在户外和室内基准测试（如 nuScenes、Waymo 和 ScanNet）上，结合两种 Transformer 骨干网络 Utonia 和 LitePT-B，SpaceCache 实现了最高 1.65 倍的加速，同时 mIoU 下降不到 1 个百分点，并 consistently 优于 Token 合并方法。
